sign_in_title: Sign in to enter the world
shared_account: Your account is shared with the LoreWeave writing app. If you already have one there, sign in with that email — no need to register again.

error.email_exists: This email already has a LoreWeave account — the same one the writing app uses. Please sign in instead.
error.validation: Email or password is not valid.
error.network: Could not reach the server. Is the gateway running?
error.password_too_short: Password must be at least 8 characters.
error.password_needs_letter: Password must contain at least one letter.
error.password_needs_digit: Password must contain at least one number.
error.reset_token_invalid: That reset code is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.

password_hint: At least 8 characters, including a letter and a number.
check_inbox: Account created. We sent a verification link to {{email}} — you can start playing now and verify later.
forgot_hint: Password recovery isn't in the game client yet — reset it from the LoreWeave writing app, then sign in here with the new password.
reset_request_intro: Enter the email on your LoreWeave account and we'll send a reset link.

reset_done: Password changed. You can sign in with it now.
